name: block-onboarding-steps
summary: Onboarding checklist with a progress bar, step states, and an action on the current step.
description: A Web block that renders an onboarding checklist: a progress bar with an accessible label, an ordered list of complete, current, and upcoming steps announced in words, aria-current on the current step, and an action slot on that step. Step status comes from the caller; built from the Card primitives, theme tokens, and lucide-react icons; all copy arrives through props and it fetches nothing.
use_when: new users or organizations should see what to set up next
the builder asks for a getting-started checklist or stepper
a console home page needs setup progress until the account is ready
